apps.name: Fluxa
apps.subtitle: Your media, in one place.
apps.versionDescription:
## What's Changed

- feat(ui): show MDBList ratings with logos on the hero and detail screens (`1e35b4c9`)
- fix(shorts): unmute trailer playback (`91c1ed9a`)
- feat(nuvio): sync profile edits, creation and deletion to the Nuvio account (`70ec0bc4`)
- feat(ui): play animated GIF avatars in the profile picker, top bar, sidebar and account (`9027033f`)
- fix(core): hide new-episode badge when unwatched backlog precedes it (`5d69d8d5`)
- feat(plugins): group repository results into one provider and show full repository URL (`5469dfb4`)
- fix(player): apply stream proxy headers to main playback (`048657fe`)
- feat(plugins): persist Cloudflare clearance and apply it to player streams (`1d468c91`)
- feat(desktop): solve Cloudflare challenges with a hidden webview (`8a39d4e2`)
- feat(plugins): solve Cloudflare challenges through a hidden WebView (`49cac6e7`)
- feat(core): cloudstream repo parser and gateway link mapping (`49e8925c`)
- feat(plugins): support Seanime streaming and torrent provider extensions (`23421596`)
- feat(ui): quick action icons in hover preview and episode info for continue watching (`414641cb`)
- feat(ui): hover preview on continue watching cards (`e744494e`)
- fix(ui): hover preview on discover/search and ignore top bar (`97a23b7a`)
- fix(web): use the portable sleep for catalog retries (`c52190a9`)
